about_the_game:
Every decade, a monstrous force of nature awakens, leaving only ruin in its wake. Its presence twists the land, warping animals into ruthless ghost packs, drawn to anything that moves. For generations, the Trackers have fought to contain the curse. But this time… they need you.

Hunt the Beast through the mist-laden valleys of Brigga! Unravel the truth behind its cursed existence and follow its trail into its den. But beware, if you wish to survive, you must learn to hunt it.



Master the art of tracking, and hunt your prey like no other. Explore and read the land to uncover hidden paths leading to ferocious predators, ready to test even the most hardened hunters. Will you bring them down, or bend them to your will?

But only those who crave the ultimate hunt will dare to follow the Beast’s trail. Each clue brings you closer to it. Follow its trails, and trust your Huntsman to chart the way, leading you to the heart of the curse itself. Track the Beast to its lair… and strike before it stirs.



But no chain can hold what was never meant to be tamed. The Beast’s curse spreads like a plague, its shadow birthing the ghost packs, spectral hunters that grow stronger with each passing night. And should your own animals falter, they too may succumb to its will.

The hunt will end in blood and ruin. Should you triumph, carve your prize from the fallen creature. The remains of the Beast hold the power to forge weapons worthy of the legend you now carry. But the curse is never truly vanquished. It only waits to rise again...
